coverage.joinPolicy: Exact 10-digit sourceCode only: province=canonicalCode+8 zeros; district=canonicalCode+5 zeros; neighborhood=canonicalCode+2 zeros. Names are not fuzzy matched. City aggregates and subordinate wards both remain separate source rows. Never assign an administrative resident total to a commercial trade area.
